bilingual.label: Bilingual EN + CN with box
bilingual.use_when: Talk outlines and explainers for a mixed audience: an English line over a Chinese line, on a semi-transparent box so it stays legible over busy footage.

clean.label: Clean tech talk
clean.use_when: Talks, demos, code walkthroughs, anything where the caption must stay out of the way. One line, no box, thin outline.

cute.label: Cute handwritten vlog
cute.use_when: Casual vlogs, travel diaries, warm community events. Handwritten feel: Caveat for English, Ma Shan Zheng for Chinese.
